description: This file implements security utilities for a FastAPI application, including JWT token handling, password hashing, user authentication, and role-based access control.

classes.name: TokenData
classes.description: Data model representing information embedded in JWT tokens, including user ID, email, roles, and expiration.

methods.name: hash_password
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with optional expiration override.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising HTTP exceptions if invalid or expired.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that retrieves the current user based on the Bearer token, verifying user existence.

methods.name: require_roles
methods.description: Dependency factory that enforces role-based access control for the current user.
